max_tire.note: About 31.2 in. FullFatRR consensus is that it won't rub in any height mode, and the spare still fits the well. 275/55R20 (about 31.9 in) is also common but may catch at full lock. Owners treat 20 in as the smallest wheel that reliably clears the brakes.

items.title: Seat SRS connector may disconnect
items.summary: The side-airbag connector under the front seats may disconnect because of insufficient clearance.

items.title: Brake vacuum hose routing
items.summary: The brake vacuum hose may be misrouted and chafe through.

items.title: Occupant classification (passenger airbag)
items.summary: A lightweight adult passenger may be misclassified, so the passenger airbag is switched off.

items.title: Doors may unlatch
items.summary: Doors may unlatch unexpectedly once closed.

items.title: Keyless door latch (KV Latch)
items.summary: Doors can look closed but still be unlatched. 20V-387 re-checks earlier repairs that may not have been done properly.

items.title: Wheel lug nuts may crack
items.summary: Lug nuts on some trucks built in January 2015 may crack and come off the stud.

items.title: Front upper knuckle may crack
items.summary: The front suspension's upper knuckle joint can crack and let a suspension arm detach. See also 24V-840 (2014–2016) and 26V-527 (wrong replacement knuckles).

items.title: Driver seat-belt retractor
items.summary: The driver's emergency-locking retractor may not lock (see also 19V-350).

items.title: Surround camera water ingress
items.summary: Water can get into the rear-view camera, giving no picture or a distorted one.

items.title: Cam carrier oil channel
items.summary: The cam-carrier oil channel may be blocked, which can cause an oil leak (Ingenium six).

tsbs.title: TDV6 / SDV6 crankshaft and bearing failure
tsbs.summary: Land Rover technical bulletin on crank-bearing failures in the 3.0 V6 diesel family. Long oil-change intervals and the wrong oil grade are suspected contributors.

timeline.change: Unveiled at the Paris Motor Show and on sale late in the year as a 2013 model. All-aluminium monocoque about 420 kg lighter than the L322, ZF 8HP on every engine, Terrain Response 2, and a 5.0 V8 (375 or 510 PS supercharged), TDV6 or SDV8.
Early trucks. Specialist guides single out pre-2015 cars for the most electrical and body faults, and recalls cover door latches, airbags and the brake vacuum hose.
Long wheelbase (3,122 mm) arrives, including the US-market Autobiography Black. 3.0 supercharged V6 (340 or 380 PS) added.
Td6 diesel (254 hp) arrives in the US.

Facelift. Four-bar grille, new LED daytime running lights, thicker glass, and a dual-screen infotainment system where a second LCD replaces the climate knobs. Seat controls move to the doors. ReRev rates 2018–21 the most reliable L405s
P400e plug-in hybrid (2.0 Ingenium, 404 PS) offered.
3.0 Ingenium straight-six mild hybrid (P400) arrives. AutoTrader.ca recommends a 2020-or-newer truck with this engine if the budget allows.
Final model year; the L460 is revealed in October 2021.

identify.intro: Nine model years, two wheelbases and seven powertrains look much alike, and the differences matter for parts, reliability and value.

items.head: Pre- or post-facelift
items.body: Trucks from 2013 to 2017 have a three-bar grille, physical climate knobs and seat switches on the seat. From the 2018 model year they have a four-bar grille, new LED DRLs and twin touchscreens, and the seat controls are on the doors.

items.head: Wheelbase
items.body: The SWB is 2,922 mm (4,999 mm long). The LWB, from 2014, adds 200 mm, giving 3,122 mm (5,199 mm long), all of it in rear legroom.

items.head: US engines
items.body: 5.0 supercharged V8 (510 PS, 525 PS from 2017); 3.0 supercharged V6 from 2014; Td6 diesel from 2016; P400e plug-in hybrid from the 2019 model year; 3.0 straight-six mild hybrid from 2020. The 4.4 SDV8 and the SDV6 Hybrid were never sold in the US.

items.head: Rear locker
items.body: Land Rover's owner guide lists separate fluid specs and fill volumes for the non-locking and electronic locking rear differentials. Check the build spec or the diff before you assume you have a locker.

items.head: SVAutobiography
items.body: The SVO-built flagship. The SVAutobiography Dynamic uses a 550 PS version of the supercharged 5.0. These trucks are worth far more than an HSE, so check the VIN-decoded build spec before paying SV money.

values.intro: Depreciation has done its work on early supercharged and Td6 trucks. Late facelift trucks with low miles still hold real money, and SVAutobiographies sit in a class of their own.
values.note: Based on 22 Bring a Trailer sales from September to October 2026 ($12,888–$100,000, median about $31,400). Low mileage, 2020–21 build dates and Westminster, Autobiography Fifty or Overfinch trucks sat at the top.
